summary: Comprehensive backend testing for the Mi Economía (ARS) FastAPI backend. All 21 pytest test cases passed (100% success). Verified: (1) auth 401 without token / with invalid session_id, /api/auth/me with valid seeded session, (2) 13 default categories seeded on user creation + custom CRUD + user-scoping, (3) transactions CRUD with AES-256 (Fernet) encryption at rest verified by inspecting Mongo docs — amount_enc/description_enc do NOT contain plaintext '99999' or 'TEST_secret_lunch' and were decrypted using ENCRYPTION_KEY from .env, (4) budget auto-recompute bug fix confirmed end-to-end (3000→8000→5000→12000 with alert triggered) purely via transaction CRUD (no manual recompute endpoint called), (5) investments CRUD with encryption + /investments/total profit/loss math, (6) CoinGecko integration live-tested: /crypto/search?q=bitcoin returns bitcoin, /crypto/price/bitcoin returns ARS/USD > 0, /crypto/sync-prices updated the current price of a seeded BTC investment, (7) analytics dashboard (default + ?month=), available-months (includes current), trends (6 entries), expenses-by-category — all user-scoped, (8) /backup/export returns a Fernet-encrypted blob that was successfully decrypted with ENCRYPTION_KEY yielding JSON with transactions/investments/budgets/categories arrays and counts matched, (9) cross-user isolation: user2's token cannot read/delete user1's categories/transactions (404 on delete, absent from GET listings).

minor.issue: Route is declared AFTER /api/budgets/{budget_id} but FastAPI still resolves it correctly because it's a static path — however by convention the static route should be declared BEFORE the parameterized one to avoid future ordering bugs. Currently working.
httpx call to demobackend.emergentagent.com has no explicit error propagation for network failures other than status!=200 — a timeout will surface as a 500. Consider try/except with 502.

action_items: No functional fixes required — backend is passing all critical flows including the reported budget auto-recompute bug fix and encryption-at-rest requirement.
(Minor / optional) Move @api_router.get('/budgets/alerts') BEFORE the /budgets/{budget_id} handlers to follow FastAPI best-practices on route ordering.
(Minor / optional) Wrap the httpx call in POST /api/auth/session with try/except to surface 502 for CoinGecko/Emergent OAuth network errors instead of 500.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~980 lines — approaching the 700-line guideline. Consider splitting into modules: auth.py, transactions.py, budgets.py, investments.py, crypto.py, analytics.py, backup.py.

DRY: month → (start_date, end_date) window logic is repeated in get_transactions, recompute_budget_spent, get_dashboard, get_expenses_by_category, get_trends. Extract to a helper like month_bounds(month:str)->(datetime,datetime).
recompute_budget_spent decrypts every expense to sum — for very large datasets this is O(N) decryption per budget read; consider materializing month totals or using a running counter.
encrypt_field / decrypt_field silently return the input on decryption failure — this could mask corrupted data. Should log a warning.

get_current_user is duplicated as a dependency call inside each endpoint via Header(None) instead of using FastAPI Depends(get_current_user). Refactor to use Depends for cleaner code and OpenAPI docs.
No rate limiting on /api/crypto/* endpoints — a single user can hammer CoinGecko free tier and get the whole app blocked.
seed_data_creation: Two TEST users were seeded via pymongo directly (session-scoped pytest fixture): user_TEST_u1_* and user_TEST_u2_*, each with their own session_token, users doc, user_sessions doc, and 13 default categories. All test-created transactions/investments/budgets/categories are prefixed 'TEST_' and cleaned up in fixture teardown (deletes all docs for those user_ids). No production data touched.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend URL: EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL from /app/frontend/.env (NOT EXPO_BACKEND_URL). MongoDB creds: MONGO_URL + DB_NAME from /app/backend/.env. ENCRYPTION_KEY (Fernet) also in .env — required to verify encryption-at-rest and /backup/export decryption. Test suite in /app/backend/tests/test_backend.py auto-creates two TEST users directly in Mongo (fixture seeds users + user_sessions + default categories) since real Emergent Google OAuth cannot be exercised from tests. Run: `pytest /app/backend/tests/ -v --junitxml=/app/test_reports/pytest/pytest_results.xml`. CoinGecko tests will skip if 502 (rate-limited).
rca_of_issue: N/A — no bugs to RCA. The reported budget auto-recompute bug is verified fixed: recompute_budget_spent is called from POST/PUT/DELETE /transactions and from POST/PUT /budgets, and reading GET /budgets returns the updated current_spent without needing any manual recompute endpoint.
